{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers (using customer_segment)
completed_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the dtype of 'revenue'
print(f'Dtype of revenue column: {sales["revenue"].dtype}')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Re-filter
completed_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print(f'Number of non-numeric revenue values in completed LOYAL orders: {completed_loyal["revenue"].isnull().sum()}')

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_loyal['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
